# With a route_paths key, muxt generate in a listed package's own directory
# still keeps the hub current: it writes that package's routes file and
# regenerates route_paths.go from every listed package, so another package can
# link to a route that was just added.

muxt generate
exec go build ./...

# Add a route to blog, and a link to it from admin.
cp blog/list.gohtml.new blog/list.gohtml
cp admin/dashboard.gohtml.new admin/dashboard.gohtml

cd blog
muxt generate
cd ..

muxt check
exec go build ./...
exec go test ./site

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": {},
		"example.com/m/blog": {}
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() string { return "dashboard" }
-- admin/dashboard.gohtml --
{{define "GET /admin Dashboard()"}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1><a id="article" href="{{.Path.Blog.GetArticle 42}}">article</a>{{end}}
-- admin/dashboard.gohtml.new --
{{define "GET /admin Dashboard()"}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1><a id="article" href="{{.Path.Blog.GetArticle 42}}">article</a><a id="list" href="{{.Path.Blog.ListArticles}}">articles</a>{{end}}
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }

func (Server) ListArticles() string { return "articles" }
-- blog/article.gohtml --
{{define "GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)"}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>{{end}}
-- blog/list.gohtml.new --
{{define "GET /articles ListArticles()"}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>{{end}}
-- site/site_test.go --
package site

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.com/m/admin"
	"example.com/m/blog"
)

func TestAdminLinksToTheNewBlogRoute(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	admin.TemplateRoutes(mux, admin.Server{})
	blog.TemplateRoutes(mux, blog.Server{})

	for target, want := range map[string]string{
		"/admin":    `id="list" href="/articles"`,
		"/articles": `<h1>articles</h1>`,
	} {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, target, nil))
		if got := rec.Result().StatusCode; got != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("GET %s status = %d, want %d", target, got, http.StatusOK)
		}
		if body := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(body, want) {
			t.Errorf("GET %s body = %q, want it to contain %q", target, body, want)
		}
	}
}
